title: Desolate planet at the edge of the Universe
content: I have a reoccurring Dream that's rather pleasant. The planet itself is simple with lichen, moss, ferns, redwood, huckleberry, rivers not much in the way of plant diversity or animal diversity. I usually arrive at the planet on a plateau inside a mile long temple/hallway/castle. I always walk the mile to meet the person I always meet. Inside the temple are massive pillers 100ft tall at least with a glass skyline and larg windows overlooking valleys. Outside the ceiling skyline are stars and a reddwarf, and multiple galaxies. When I make it to the central chamber is a goddess like being. Red skined, horns like a Stagg, purple misty eyes, muscular, wings of blue, red, purple. A long multicolored spiky tail as long as a wipe. Ears pointed, scaly covers like an exoskeleton covers the parts of the body where skin meets bones. The central chamber is a circle, here throne is perched on a hill in the center with a big pond of clear water with 2 smaller mounds with an Oak tree on one and an apple tree on the other. Black, white, and red marble line the whole room with an incredible view of the multiverse. This is a super fun reoccurring dream I have. Very peaceful
